Symbolic identities and finite-energy examples are independently reproducible but are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Large predator–prey oscillations generate rare bursts, making typical concentrations and predation throughput sharply different observables. The coupled two-clock theorem quantifies the near-extinction logarithmic share and the active-interaction linear share, produces an all-order mixed-moment spectrum and exhibits how fixed mean reaction flux coexists with increasingly large co-occurrence moments. This is a natural statistical-geometric invariant of the canonical oscillator, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
